job.description: N14's full-length calibration run, before any real N14 run: seed 3001 only. Trains the seven new arms (r10, r20, r40, sub10, sub05, sub025, sub20-rw) at full length and re-measures N12's calibration models sub20 and n80-mix of seed 3001 (read from the n12_calib Drive folder) on the held-out tail's windows 513-1024. It decides nothing: it checks that the clean-target ladder brackets n80-mix's loss, and records one seed's values. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 20 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
